preconditions.description: The number of brains in the final nervous system is between 2 and 200000 inclusive.
The input contains exactly n-1 parent connections (p2, p3, ..., pn).

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= p_k <= k - 1 for k in range(2, n + 1))
preconditions.description: Each parent connection p_k for brain k is a valid existing brain number (1 ≤ p_k ≤ k-1).

postconditions.description: The output contains exactly n-1 latency values, one for each brain addition step.

postconditions.expression: all(output[k - 2] == max_distance_from_root(k, p) for k in range(2, n + 1))
postconditions.description: For each brain k (2 ≤ k ≤ n), the output latency is the maximum distance from brain k to any other brain in the current nervous system (1 ≤ ... ≤ k).
